description: Source code for Wi-Fi access point configuration management, including parsing, reading, writing, and setting configuration parameters.

methods.name: field_by_name
methods.description: Finds a configuration field by its name within hapd_cfg_t structure.

methods.name: field_by_index
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration field by its index in the field_map array.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: hapd_parse_line
methods.description: Parses a line from configuration file and updates the hapd_cfg_t structure accordingly.

methods.name: hapd_reset_cfg
methods.description: Resets all configuration fields to NULL and marks configuration as invalid.

methods.name: hapd_read_cfg
methods.description: Reads configuration from a file and populates hapd_cfg_t structure.

methods.name: hapd_write_cfg
methods.description: Writes current configuration to a file.

methods.name: hapd_set_cfg
methods.description: Sets a configuration parameter to a specified value.

methods.name: hapd_get_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified configuration parameter.

methods.name: hapd_print_cfg
methods.description: Prints current configuration parameters for debugging.
